about.title: About Sri Venkata Sai Devasthanam
about.subtitle: Discover the history, founding vision, and spiritual significance of Sri Venkata Sai Devasthanam
about.significanceDesc1: A place of divine grace where thousands find peace, solace, and spiritual renewal through daily worship and meditation.
about.significanceDesc2: Through Annadanam and social welfare programs, the temple serves all regardless of caste, creed, or social status.
about.significanceDesc3: The temple preserves and promotes traditional Hindu culture, arts, and religious practices for future generations.
about.archDesc: Sri Venkata Sai Devasthanam is built in the traditional Dravidian architectural style, featuring a gopuram (gateway tower) adorned with colorful sculptures of deities and mythological figures. The sanctum sanctorum houses the main deity with appropriate agamic specifications. The mandapam provides space for devotees to observe the poojas.
about.foundersDesc: Sri Venkata Sai Devasthanam was established through the collective vision and devotion of a group of spiritual individuals from Yemmiganur who sought to create a sacred space for the community. The temple is managed by a dedicated trust committee committed to maintaining transparency and service.
about.historyPara1: Sri Venkata Sai Devasthanam was established in 2004 by a group of devoted individuals in Yemmiganur, Kurnool District of Andhra Pradesh. The temple was born from a deeply-felt spiritual need of the local community for a place of worship dedicated to Lord Sri Venkateshwara Swamy and Sai Baba.
about.historyPara2: Over the years, the temple has grown from a modest structure to a vibrant spiritual center serving thousands of devotees. The temple follows traditional Hindu rituals and agamic practices, maintaining the sanctity and authenticity of ancient worship.
about.historyPara3: Today, Sri Venkata Sai Devasthanam stands as a beacon of hope, devotion, and community service in the region, conducting daily poojas, weekly sevas, annual brahmotsavams, and the beloved annadanam program.
about.timeline0desc: Sri Venkata Sai Devasthanam was founded with devotion and community support.
about.timeline1desc: Grand annual brahmotsavam celebration began with thousands of devotees.
about.timeline2desc: Daily free food service (annadanam) launched to serve the community.
about.timeline3desc: Major renovation and expansion of the main sanctum and facilities.
about.timeline4desc: Temple YouTube channel and website launched for wider reach.
about.timeline5desc: Celebrating two decades of devotion, service, and community welfare.

annadanam.title: Annadanam Program
annadanam.subtitle: Feeding the divine in every individual
annadanam.description: Annadanam (food donation) is considered one of the greatest acts of charity in Hindu tradition. 'Annam Brahma' — Food is God. Daily, our temple provides free meals to hundreds of devotees, pilgrims, and those in need.
annadanam.whatPara1: Annadanam — the gift of food — is considered the greatest of all charitable acts in Hindu tradition. The ancient saying Annam Brahma (Food is God) underscores the profound spiritual significance of feeding others.
annadanam.whatPara2: At Sri Venkata Sai Devasthanam, free meals (prasadam) are served every day of the year to devotees, pilgrims, and the underprivileged — regardless of caste, religion, or social status. This is our way of serving God in every human being.
annadanam.whatPara3: The program is sustained entirely through the generosity of donors and sponsors. By sponsoring a day of Annadanam, you participate in this act of divine service and receive the blessings of Lord Sri Venkateshwara Swamy and Sai Baba.
annadanam.sponsorNote: Choose a sponsorship level that fits your heart. Every contribution, big or small, provides nourishment and divine blessings.
annadanam.step1Desc: Select a sponsorship amount based on your wish
annadanam.step4Desc: Your name is announced during Annadanam
